contract: POST /api/feeds/item/:itemId/open. Admin-only. 404 unknown item (checked before the body), 403 when the admin cannot access the item's library, 400 for a missing/non-string serverAddress or slug or an item without audio tracks, 400 when the slug is in use. On success persists one feed (slug as id, metadata-derived fields, absolute image/site URLs) and one feed episode per audio track, and emits rss_feed_open with the minified feed.
exceptions: force is not applicable: no feed route has a force, hard or override mode; a feed is refreshed implicitly when its entity is newer than entityUpdatedAt.
serverAddress is persisted and returned but never used to build feed URLs (the live request origin is used, RssFeedManager.js:186); the scenarios assert both facts.
The 500 'Failed to open RSS feed' branch requires a database failure inside the create transaction (Feed.js:184-188); it is not reachable through the API and is not asserted.
Error response text ('Invalid request body', 'Slug already in use', 'Item has no audio tracks') is shown as a toast by the client but not parsed; only statuses are asserted.

invariants.contract: POST /api/feeds/item/:itemId/open by an admin answers 200 with {feed: minified} and, in one transaction, persists a feeds row with slug=the request slug, entityType 'libraryItem', entityId=the item, entityUpdatedAt=max(item.updatedAt, book/podcast updatedAt), serverAddress exactly as sent, feedURL /feed/:slug, imageURL /feed/:slug/cover<ext>?ts=<entityUpdatedAt> or /Logo.png when there is no cover, siteURL /item/:itemId, title/description/author from the media, podcastType 'serial' for books, language, explicit, preventIndexing (default true), ownerName/ownerEmail (only string values, else NULL), coverPath and userId=the caller, plus one feedEpisode per track or podcast episode (title, author, siteURL, enclosureURL /feed/:slug/item/:episodeId/media<ext>, enclosureType, enclosureSize, pubDate offset one minute per track from the item createdAt in GMT, duration, podcast season/episode/episodeType, filePath, explicit). The opened feed is listed and its unauthenticated XML, cover and enclosure serve the persisted values, and a later media change is reflected by a new feed opened for the same item.

The route is rejected in upstream's order: 404 for an unknown item even without a body, then 403 for an admin denied the item's library, then 400 for a missing body, a non-string or missing serverAddress/slug, an item without audio tracks, and a slug already used by any feed. A non-admin gets 403 from the route middleware and an anonymous caller 401. Every rejection persists no feed or episode row and emits no rss_feed_open.
